WORK_RESEARCH.intent: Study complete food-comic works only to improve appetite, rhythm, restraint and readable six-panel pacing. Do not promote observations into hard gates without repeated evidence.

RADAR.intent: Choose a concrete menu/moment capable of sustaining six publishable sensory beats without procedural filler.

EDITORIAL.intent: Define the PROXY_EATER appetite arc and map exactly six publishable beats. Slot roles remain story-dependent.

STORYBOARD.intent: Plan exactly six publishable beats, copy and minimal continuity, then stop for STORYBOARD_USER_GATE. This user gate is permanent. Camera/pose/expression/per-cell composition remain fluid.

ASSET_PRODUCTION.intent: Compatibility stage name only: after storyboard approval, continue in the same ChatGPT conversation. Attach only the approved JIPBAP_STYLE_CARRIER_V1 once, generate one text-free 2x3 master board, and apply V1 hard-fail QC. Raw creative references are not normal production renderer inputs. While carrier calibration is active, expose one temporary BOARD_STYLE_USER_GATE.

COMPOSITION.intent: After BOARD PASS, continue in the same conversation. Deterministically extract six cells, fit 4:5 BODY pages, assemble the cover, and apply editable lettering. Layout/copy-only defects never authorize stochastic board regeneration.

QC.intent: Use only V1 publish-blocking hard fails. In steady state, user gates are storyboard approval and final publish approval; the board/style gate is temporary and removable after carrier stability is proven.
